title: MoneyFigure: amounts and ranges in Indian format
summary: A presentational MoneyFigure component and pure formatters (`formatInr`, `formatInrCompact`, `formatInrRange`) for amounts and ranges: en-IN grouping (1,50,000), lakh/crore compact form, tabular figures, ink colours only — never gold, never a tier mark. Screen readers hear ranges as “to”.
migration: Additive. modules/financial-eligibility/presentation.ts keeps its own formatInr; it can import from @/design/money later (same output). Respect the rule that creators never see recommendation figures before partner-lender review.
